info.name: Admin

item.name: Get Dashboard
item.description: All admin endpoints require ADMIN role. Non-admin requests receive 403.

request.description:
Returns all data needed to render the admin dashboard in a single request. All 17 database queries run in parallel.

Role: ADMIN only.

Sections returned:
- stats: platform-wide counts (users, landlords, properties, feedback)
- recentRegistrations: last 5 sign-ups (excludes admins)
- latestProperties: last 5 property listings created
- topProperties: top 5 published properties by view count
- recentFeedback: last 5 feedback submissions

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Returns a landlord's profile and all their property listings (published and unpublished). Used for the landlord detail page in the admin panel.

Role: ADMIN only.

Errors:
